blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–John Cabang Tolentino won the Philippines’ first medal in the athletics competition of the Asian Games 2026 after a bronze finish in the men’s 110-meter hurdles final on Sunday night at Mizuho Park Stadium. Tolentino clocked a season-best 13.48 seconds to finish behind China’s Chen Yuanjiang, who won gold in 13.15, and Japan’s Rachid Muratake, who took silver in 13.29. The bronze ended the Philippines’ long wait for a medal in the event since Elma Muros won bronze in 1990 and marked the first Asian Games hurdles medal […]...
